title: AI: Terrible and Wonderful
_schema_notes: Top-level fields:
title              -- browser tab + accessible label
startNode          -- node id loaded when no #hash is present
choiceDisplaySeconds -- countdown for end-of-segment choices (used when showChoicesAt is not set)
masterVideoId      -- default YouTube videoId for all nodes that don't set their own
Node fields:
id                 -- unique, used in URL hash
title              -- shown in header and tab
videoId            -- optional; overrides masterVideoId
start, end         -- optional seconds into source video for this segment
showChoicesAt      -- optional seconds; if set, choices appear mid-segment instead of at end
choices[]          -- buttons to navigate to other nodes
isAside            -- visual: marks the node as a deep dive
defaultAside       -- shows persistent 'Skip -> back to main' button (requires returnTo)
returnTo           -- node id to auto-route to when this segment ends
endScreen          -- shown for terminal nodes (no choices, no returnTo)
Choice fields:
label, target      -- required
default            -- exactly one per node should be true; auto-fires after countdown
style              -- 'primary' or 'secondary'
Any field starting with '_' is ignored by both the player and validator -- use for inline notes.
